changes.comment: Decouple core from database row types with domain models (TaskModel, SessionModel, EnvironmentModel, PersonaModel, EscalationModel). Move ToolConfigSpec/McpServerSpec to @grackle-ai/common. Update PersonaResolveInput/ResolvedPersona in @grackle-ai/prompt to use parsed types. Update dep interfaces in plugin-core, plugin-scheduling, and server to use domain model types at the core boundary.
